seoTitle: Master of Flags: Free Flag Quiz for iPhone, Mac and Apple TV
metaDescription: A free flag and capitals quiz with no ads and no subscription. Daily Challenge, streaks, a 250-flag encyclopedia, Apple Watch and Couch Mode on Apple TV.
heroSubhead: A flag and capitals quiz that respects you: no ads, no subscription, no account. A wrong answer shows the right flag, its capital and what to look for. Free on iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple TV and Apple Watch.
highlights: No ads, no subscription, no account
Wrong answers teach the right flag, its capital and what to look for
A ten-question Daily Challenge with a streak that forgives
One optional Pro purchase covers iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple TV

features.title: Wrong answers teach
features.body: Miss a flag and the tiles show the right one, its capital and what to look for. Right answers move on by themselves, and nothing ever blocks the next flag.

features.title: Flags and capitals, six regions
features.body: Name the flag or match the capital across Europe, Asia, Africa, the Americas, Oceania and the whole world. Every region and both modes are free.

features.title: A Daily Challenge with a fair streak
features.body: Ten flags, once a day, the same set for everyone, with a result you can share as a picture. Seven of ten keeps your streak, freezes cover a skipped day and a 48-hour repair window forgives a broken run.

features.title: Learn, the flag encyclopedia
features.body: About 250 flags and territories with capitals, facts and the story behind each flag. Search by nickname or native name, so Holland and Deutschland both work, and look-alike flags are one tap away.

features.title: Every Apple screen
features.body: A real Mac app with a sidebar, menu bar and keyboard shortcuts. The full game on Apple TV, with Couch Mode for two to four players. Flash questions and your Daily streak on Apple Watch, and widgets for the Home Screen, Lock Screen and StandBy.

features.title: Pro: drill what you miss
features.body: Smart Review brings back the flags you miss on a spaced schedule. Similar Flags drills the look-alikes, Chad and Romania, Indonesia and Monaco. Hard Mode, full statistics, Daily Archive replay and five streak freezes a month round it out.

pricing.heading: Free to play. Pro is one purchase.

pricing.footnote: US price shown; your local price appears in the App Store. There is no subscription. If you bought Master of Flags when it was a paid app, Pro is already yours: tap Restore Purchases.

faq.q: Is Master of Flags really free?
faq.a: Yes. Both quiz modes, all six regions, the Daily Challenge, streaks, the encyclopedia and Game Center are free, with no ads and no account. Pro is optional.

faq.q: What does Pro unlock, and what does it cost?
faq.a: Pro is a one-time $6.99 purchase. It adds Hard Mode, Smart Review, Similar Flags, full statistics, replay of any past Daily Challenge and five streak freezes a month instead of one. There is no subscription.

faq.q: Do I pay again on another device, or for my family?
faq.a: No. Pro is a Universal Purchase across iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple TV, and Family Sharing lets your family use it too. If it does not appear on a device, tap Restore Purchases.

faq.q: I bought the app years ago when it was paid. Do I pay again?
faq.a: No. Everyone who bought it during the paid era gets Pro automatically, free, forever. Tap Restore Purchases on a new device to bring it back.

Nothing is collected: no accounts, analytics, ads or tracking. Your progress, streak and bookmarks can follow you across your devices through your own iCloud account. The flags and encyclopedia are bundled with the app, and only Game Center and purchases need a connection.

faq.q: Which devices and languages are supported?
faq.a: iPhone and iPad with iOS 18 or later, Mac with macOS 26 or later, Apple TV with tvOS 18 or later and Apple Watch with watchOS 11 or later. The app is translated into English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Brazilian Portuguese, and Simplified and Traditional Chinese.
